changelog:
wechat-formatter 1.0.0 – initial release

- Converts .doc/.docx files or pasted text into "谓无名" WeChat article markdown.
- Strictly preserves original content; does not rewrite, summarize, or invent missing info.
- Adds 编者按 (~500 chars) in required syntax and position for every article.
- Extracts and structures Word document elements according to editor markdown rules.
- Searches for key persons, books, and media; downloads and uploads images to public host with error handling and reporting.
- Reports source issues (typos, compliance risks, missing info) in 校对提醒 after the markdown.
- Supports Python 3 docx extraction and LibreOffice normalization for broader file compatibility.
summary: Convert uploaded .doc/.docx files or pasted text into WeChat article markdown using the "谓无名" editor syntax. Use when the user uploads Word documents, pastes...
